message.content: {"decision":"accept","reason":"This arXiv paper presents a novel, detailed workflow (Say, Do, Understand) for analyzing how developers interact with coding agents, linking prompts, actions, and understanding, based on an observational study with GitHub Copilot. It offers concrete evidence from first-hand observation and coding rubrics, revealing distinct developer personas and testing habits that learners can reflect on when delegating tasks to agents. This contributes a fresh research perspective on human-AI communication in coding relevant to learners' delegation and review practices.","piece_ids":["01","02"],"strongest_claim":"The Say, Do, Understand workflow reveals distinct developer personas in how they use and understand coding agents, showing that some developers rely on agent testing while others test more themselves, with implications for how learners should balance delegation and verification.","evidence_type":"method","perspective":"research","commercial_incentive":false}
